labels.notes: The label is unmarked and the row stays partial, as the dispatch requires. The ledger regex (tools/ledger.py docstring_label_re: **`(cex|...):...`**) finds no mark in the first 4000 characters or anywhere else in the file. The label bullet is at character 324, unmarked, and cites `RamcovGX.tex:1930`, the \begin{cex} line. The only bold-backticked tokens are the declaration names **`GX.troyanovTheorem_of_ne_two_pi`** and **`GX.troyanovTheorem_of_four_le_of_ne_two_pi`** (l.13, l.15). Bold declaration names are house style, and the ledger does not read them. The quoted block matches l.1930 verbatim, apart from line wrapping. The open obligations are Troyanov for s >= 4 with all θ_i ≠ 2π (T-gx-troyanov-polygon, T-gx-troyanov) and GX.thurstonSuspensionFacts (scaffold TroyanovAngles.lean:329). CHECKED (1): the inline Prop is exactly GX.TroyanovTheorem. A MetaM probe imported GX and GXScaffold (which contains TroyanovAngles) and pasted this module's source. It took the conclusion of troyanovTheorem_of_ne_two_pi and of troyanovTheorem_of_four_le_of_ne_two_pi (no loose bvars, since the arrow is non-dependent) and compared each with the value of GX.TroyanovTheorem (TroyanovAngles.lean:229-232). Both are Expr-equal (==) and defeq. The left side of troyanovTheorem_iff_four_le_ne_two_pi is also Expr-equal to that value, and its right side is Expr-equal to the hypothesis of troyanovTheorem_of_four_le_of_ne_two_pi. `example (h4 : ...) : GX.TroyanovTheorem := GX.troyanovTheorem_of_four_le_of_ne_two_pi h4` typechecks. CHECKED (2): the hypotheses are the honest restrictions. The probe elaborated, independently of the file, `∀ {s} θ, TroyanovAngleCondition θ → (∀ i, θ i ≠ 2π) → ∃ M ..., IsConeSphere M θ p` and the same with `4 ≤ s →` in front. These are Expr-equal to H1 and H2 respectively, so each conclusion is unchanged and only the premise is restricted. Neither hypothesis is stronger than the conclusion: TroyanovTheorem → H1 is `fun h _ θ hθ _ => h θ hθ`, and the iff gives TroyanovTheorem → H2. Neither restriction is empty, and the ≠ 2π restriction is a genuine one. The scaffold's GX.troyanovAngleCondition_two_pi gives (9π/10, 19π/20, π, 2π), which satisfies the condition with an angle of 2π. (7π/6, 7π/6, 7π/6, 7π/6) satisfies it at s = 4 with all angles ≠ 2π: χ' = 2π/3 ∈ ]0, 7π/6]. So these are reductions, not vacuities, and the second is an equivalence. CHECKED (3): IsConePoint.of_mem_reg. Its signature is `∀ {M : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace M] [SingularGXStructure SO3 Sph2 M] {θ : ConeAngle}, ↑θ = 2π → ∀ {x}, x ∈ Reg SO3 Sph2 M → IsConePoint θ x`. Its only hypotheses are θ = 2π and x regular, with no T2, local connectedness, compactness or other side condition. GX.IsConePoint is the strict one (`#print`: HasXAType θ x, ConeSurface.lean:872). The file defines no def, structure or instance, only theorems. The reading of 'an X_{2π}-chart onto C_{2π}' (roadmap title) is the strict definition. XAChart (Models.lean:610) asks for x ∈ U open, V ⊆ C_θ open and connected, φ : U ≃ₜ V an a.e. morphism, and φ x ∈ S_θ = {apex}. That is def:atlas (RamcovGX.tex:1907) word for word: 'V ⊂ X_α open and connected … φ(x) ∈ S_α'. So 'onto a connected open neighbourhood of the apex' is the paper's chart, not a narrowing. A chart onto all of C_{2π} would be a different and generally false property, since U ≃ₜ C_{2π} fails on a small M. CHECKED (4): the supporting lemmas. IsConeSphere.insertNth requires θ_k = 2π, a cone sphere for removeNth θ, and q ∉ range p. IsConeSphere.removeNth requires θ_k = 2π. TroyanovAngleCondition.removeNth requires θ_k = 2π. These are the necessary side conditions and nothing more. TroyanovAngleCondition.three_le_card_filter_ne_two_pi has the same statement as the scaffold's three_le_card_ne_two_pi (TroyanovAngles.lean:127), as SCOPE (c) says. The REPORT's finding ('not a defect': an angle 2π is a marked regular point, so Troyanov at l.1930 is equivalent to its case s >= 4 with all θ_i ≠ 2π) is true in the library's reading (isConePoint_iff_mem_reg, troyanovTheorem_iff_four_le_ne_two_pi). It is not presented as an error in the paper.

docstring_contract: Present and in order: the title; the label `cex:start_singular_manifold_homeomorphic` — `RamcovGX.tex:1930`, unmarked, at character 324; the quoted block (verbatim); an extra '## The argument' section; '## Hypothesis checklist' (character 3074); '## SCOPE (disclosed)' (a)-(d) (character 3408, within the 8000 the ledger reads); and the Provenance line (4528). The argument section is accurate. The checklist is true. Its third row ('Troyanov's theorem (MR1005085), cited | reduced: to s ≥ 4, all θ_i ≠ 2π') has no ✓/⚠ symbol, as in TroyanovTriangle, because a cited theorem is neither carried nor weakened. The SCOPE claims are all true. (a): reductions only, with what remains named, and thurstonSuspensionFacts exists (TroyanovAngles.lean:329). (b): the chart is def:atlas's, onto a connected open neighbourhood of the apex, and of_mem_reg assumes only the singular (SO(3), 𝕊²)-structure. (c): the Prop is restated inline (Expr-equal, CHECKED (1)), and the three_le_card copy has the same statement. (d): M : Type in the reductions. The Provenance cross-references exist in strict: troyanovTheorem_three and TroyanovAngleCondition.three_half (TroyanovTriangle), SphCone/IsConePoint/IsConeSphere and SphCone.sing_eq_empty (ConeSurface), isAEMorphism_of_val_comp (Models.lean:447), and reg_opensSingular and isAEMorphism_opensSingular_val (Tame.lean:174-177). The header phrase '(…; DEC-136, Troyanov's theorem proved, not assumed)' glosses the ruling (DECISIONS.md: 'to be PROVED in full'). It is the same header as the graduated TroyanovTriangle, and l.7 and SCOPE (a) disclose that nothing is marked and only reductions are proved, so it is not counted as a finding.
